Definition: from G5078; an artisan; figuratively, a founder (Creator):--builder, craftsman.
BiblicalUsage: The word is a craftsman, a workman skilled in his trade. Demetrius the silversmith made silver shrines for Diana and brought no small gain unto the craftsmen; Abraham looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God; and in fallen Babylon the voice of craftsmen shall be heard no more at all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the craftsman matters: Demetrius used his skill for an idol, and God is the builder of the city that lasts.
